recent_commits.message: Attempt some clarification of the Authentication Granularity section and reference RFC9525 for server certificate name validation (#412)
Simplify iss wordings around trust establishment and key distribution (#411)
Added text on exposure window associated with workload deprovisioning or compromise (#393)
Creds: validate a credential only against its trust domain anchors (#370) (#403)
Update mutual TLS section with WIMSE certificate options (#407)
Refine server validation requirements for WIMSE clients (#408)
Refresh the wimsey implementation status date (#406)
Allow a server-generated request nonce from Accept-Signature (#369) (#404)
Correct author name casing for J. Salowey (#405)
Specify Simple String Comparison for wimse-aud verification (#396). (#399)
propose text to allow http401 and WWW-authenticate with WIT (#402)
Try to clarify always server and sometimes client authentication in the transport bullet of the Message Flow breakdown (#397)
Shepherd review: address Justin's HTTP-Sig notes (#385) (#386)
Update Workload Identity section for clarity (#395)
Differentiate cloud provider credential from a workload identity (#78)
Reworked intro to remove normative language
Clarify workload uniqueness and fix references
Revise Identity Mapping section and fix references
Update Workload Identifier specification and URI parsing
Fix typo in Workload Identifier Origins description
Clarify Workload Identifier uniqueness and stability #72
separate recordings box a bit more
tweak CSS for boxes on main screen
make single recordings button with list
Improved landing page for the WIMSE project
